{"predictors": [
{"name": "Research and Development Expense Variability", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of research and development expenses over the past 5 years, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with highly variable R&D expenses may be more likely to experience breakthroughs or setbacks, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Stock Option Delta", "construction": "Estimate the sensitivity of employee stock options to changes in stock price using the Black-Scholes model, aggregated across all option grants over the past 3 years", "rationale": "Firms with high option delta may have more motivated employees, leading to better future performance", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration Herfindahl Index", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of customer concentrations from Compustat Segments data over the past 5 years", "rationale": "Firms with low customer concentration may be more resilient to economic downturns, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Interdependence", "construction": "Calculate the proportion of cost of goods sold accounted for by the top 5 suppliers, using Compustat and vendor data from Specialized Information Services", "rationale": "Firms with high supply chain interdependence may be more vulnerable to supplier disruptions, leading to lower expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Board Member Connectedness", "construction": "Calculate the number of board members with connections to other S&P 500 companies, using BoardEx data", "rationale": "Firms with well-connected board members may have better access to information and resources, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Policy Stringency", "construction": "Calculate a weighted average of environmental policy stringency indices from the OECD, using sales data to weight by geographic segment", "rationale": "Firms operating in stringent environmental policy regimes may be more likely to innovate and reduce costs, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Product Lifecycle Stage", "construction": "Estimate the product lifecycle stage using a combination of R&D expense, sales growth, and industry classification", "rationale": "Firms with products in the growth stage of the lifecycle may be more likely to experience rapid expansion and high returns", "higher_returns_for": "firms with products in the growth stage"},
{"name": "Geographic Segment Diversification", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of sales across geographic segments from Compustat Segments data", "rationale": "Firms with diversified geographic segments may be more resilient to regional economic shocks, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Executive Compensation Horizon", "construction": "Estimate the average vesting period of executive compensation using proxy statement data from Thomson Reuters", "rationale": "Firms with longer executive compensation horizons may have more patient and long-term focused management, leading to higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Investor Base Diversification", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl index of institutional investor holdings from Thomson Reuters data", "rationale": "Firms with diversified investor bases may be less subject to the whims of individual investors, leading to lower volatility and higher expected returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
